similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the iconic five-story pagoda of Senso-ji. It features a solid stone base, five progressively smaller square stories with detailed red facades, white-latticed windows, and dark grey tiled roofs with flared eaves (modeled using frustum_pyramid with topR < botR to ensure correct outward-downward slope). The top is crowned with a highly detailed golden finial (sorin) composed of layered cylinders, rings, and a flame-like spire. The structure is fully enclosed and symmetric, ensuring a complete 360-degree representation.
